item: the advanced-search fixture starts its store the way the app does
refs: PR pending; found by WAL, after e5a35e922 (#1410)
summary: test_every_q601_filter_is_reachable failed alone in a fresh process and passed after any other small test: the fixture wrote country fr before the first TestClient boot stamped the shared store alpha-3, so a query for FRA bound FRA against a stored fr. The fixture now points the settings store at its own file and stamps it before writing rows (init_db's order), so the form rows are written in and the form queries bind are one marker.
